This also deals 150 damage per tick to [[units]]. |music-1 = [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Harvesting Season Theme|center|250px|thumb]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Looks like Lord Sinister is coming to end us all!
We're doomed!
Whats this?
The lights are back on.
The town is alive again!...
And the town's citizens are back to reclaim their town!|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] dialogue on Wave 18 ([[Trick or Threat Town]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Lord Sinister''' was a major boss that appeared exclusively in [[Trick or Threat Town]] as the final boss of the [[Halloween 2020 Event]]. As with most major bosses, '''Lord Sinister''' had an extremely high amount of health, but walked very slowly. '''Lord Sinister''' had three abilities: #Its ''Sinister Taunt'' ability spawned a random number of enemies from the ground. These could have been the [[Reanimated]], [[Slime (Trick or Threat Town)|Slime]], [[Hallow Bones]] and [[Ghost (Trick or Threat Town)|Ghost]]. #Its ''Hallowed Slam'' ability involved '''Lord Sinister''' slamming its axe into the ground, creating a forward shockwave that stunned towers. #Finally, its ''Infernal Storm'' ability involved '''Lord Sinister''' breathing fire at towers, setting them alight, stunning them. This attack also dealt damage to [[units]], 150 damage per tick. ==Appearance== '''Lord Sinister''' was a large demonic-like boss. It had a black pumpkin head, with glowing yellow eyes and mouth, and wore a black rusted crown. It wore bronze armor, which included a large chestplate, pauldrons and leggings. On its torso was an engraving of a spooky pumpkin face. '''Lord Sinister's''' arms were neon yellow and it wore grey gloves with white knuckles. '''Lord Sinister's''' legs were marbled crimson. Around its left leg was a neon yellow chain. '''Lord Sinister''' wielded a large axe with its right hand. The axe's design appeared to have a face. ==Strategy== *Towers that have a high DPS output are recommended, such as the [[Ranger]], [[Minigunner]] and [[Turret]]. **Because [[Trick or Threat Town]] has lots of suitable cliff space, the [[Ranger]] is ideal. *The [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability can be used to boost the firerate of towers. If you have multiple [[Commander]]s, you can chain their abilities to ensure firerate is always at its lowest. *Due to '''Lord Sinister's''' [[Freeze Immunity]], the [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Freezer]] cannot slow down '''Lord Sinister'''. **The [[Electroshocker]] can only slow down '''Lord Sinister''' instead of stunning it. Additionally, it can only slow it down for a very short period of time due to its large size. *Make sure that you have sufficient towers after the path crosses the bridge, otherwise enemies that '''Lord Sinister''' spawns may get out of range. **The [[Ghost (Trick or Threat Town)|Ghost]] can especially cause havoc as it has hidden and ghost immunity, meaning it cannot collide with [[units]]. *'''Lord Sinister's''' stuns can stun towers for a long period of time. You can use the [[Medic]]'s ability to cleanse your towers of '''Lord Sinister's''' stun. *While [[units]], like the [[Railgun Tank]] and [[Citizen 1]], can be effective against '''Lord Sinister's''' summoned enemies, '''Lord Sinister's''' ''Infernal Storm'' can pretty much destroy most [[units]]. ==Sounds== {{Sounds| {{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" {{!}}- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" {{!}}Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" {{!}}Description {{!}}- ! colspan{{=}}"2" {{!}}Summon Abilities {{!}}- {{!}}[[File:SinisterLaugh.ogg]] {{!}}''Sinister Taunt'' ability {{!}}- ! colspan{{=}}"2" {{!}}Stun Abilities {{!}}- {{!}}[[File:LordSinisterSlash.ogg]] {{!}}''Hallowed Slam'' ability {{!}}- {{!}}[[File:LordSinisterHome.ogg]] {{!}}One of ''Hallowed Slam's'' voicelines:

''"It's harvesting season!"'' {{!}}} }} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} HalloweenThumbnail.jpg|'''Lord Sinister''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} 19a99f69b078fd2b0ec2f1bc656659b9.png|'''Lord Sinister''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Halloween Trailer|'''Lord Sinister's''' voice in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} Halloween2020Clean.png|'''Lord Sinister''' on a render. {{GalleryHeader|Badges}} Halloween2020Badge.png|'''Lord Sinister''' on the “[https://www.roblox.com/badges/2124630354/Halloween-2020 Halloween 2020]” [[Badges/Event|badge]]. }} ==Trivia== *'''Lord Sinister''' is based on ''Lord Sinister'' from a boss fight game made by BelowNatural, which is no longer playable. Footage of it can be found [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NwR2L-M4Qak here]. **'''Lord Sinister''' that appears in Tower Defense Simulator can be considered a remake of that ''Lord Sinister''. *'''Lord Sinister''' is the first enemy to have voice acting. **'''Lord Sinister's''' voice actor is {{RLinkU|Razuatix}}, a retired Tower Defense Simulator developer. **'''Lord Sinister''' has an unused voiceline that could be heard during the [[April Fools 2022]], if it was picked as the random sound. The voiceline was: ''"It's harvesting season!"'' ***This voiceline was likely meant to be one of the playable sounds for ''Hallowed Slam''. *The [[Gladiator]]'s {{Color|Pumpkin|Pumpkin}} skin is heavily based on '''Lord Sinister'''. *When '''Lord Sinister''' died, its head fell off and rolled a short distance. '''Lord Sinister''' also screamed "''Nooo!''". *The Level 5 [[Farm|{{Color|Spooky|Graveyard}} Farm]] has a statue of '''Lord Sinister''', possibly being its grave. *'''Lord Sinister's''' theme (''Harvesting Season Theme'') was a remix of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=if_SbEv2We0 Mega Man Star Force 2 OST - T27: Wave Battle (Boss Theme)]. **Interestingly, the original track was used by [[w:c:r2da:Lord Pumpkin Jr.|Lord Pumpkin Jr.]], an event boss in ''R2DA'' which BelowNatural worked on. *'''Lord Sinister's''' axe design was based on the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Horseless_Headless_Horsemann's_Headtaker Horseless Headless Horsemann's Headtaker] from ''Team Fortress 2''. *'''Lord Sinister's''' crown was the {{RLinkC|1078202|Black Iron Crown of Pwnage}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *Weirdly, the health of the '''Lord Sinister''' was increased in [[MEGA Servers]] by 15,000 per player, despite it not being able to spawn in a [[MEGA Servers|MEGA Server]] without admin commands. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.1|Overhaul v1.1.0]] **'''Lord Sinister''' added. *''' 23 November 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.1|Overhaul v1.1.1]] **Health increased from 150,000 to 200,000. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Lord Sinister''' removed. {{TrickTown|[[Hallow Guard (Trick or Threat Town)|Hallow Guard]]|Wave 17|Lord Sinister|Wave 18|End|N/A}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
